name: Monster Beverage

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Monster Beverage logo.png, 289x76 px)

description: Monster owns energy-drink brands and outsources nearly all making and delivery. Its cans are filled by third-party bottlers and canners and then sold and delivered by Coca-Cola system bottlers under distribution agreements; in return The Coca-Cola Company holds a large equity stake in Monster. Coca-Cola Europacific Partners alone was 15 percent of 2025 net sales and Coca-Cola Consolidated 10 percent. Monster Energy (finished cans) is 92 percent of sales; a second segment sells concentrate to bottlers for energy brands it bought from Coca-Cola in 2015 and for its own Predator and Fury. A small loss-making craft-alcohol segment sells flavored malt beverages. There is no dividend.

sub.name: Drinks (soft drinks, energy drinks, beer and spirits)

businessLines.name: Monster Energy Drinks
businessLines.how: Monster sells finished cans of energy drink to bottler-distributors and retailers; higher revenue per case than concentrate but lower gross margin per case. Co-packers make the drinks; Coca-Cola bottlers and other distributors deliver them.
businessLines.description: Monster Energy, Reign Total Body Fuel, Reign Storm, and Bang Energy drinks.

operatingProfit.label: Segment operating income excluding corporate and unallocated expenses; the 10-K gives '$2.98 billion', +20.9%

businessLines.name: Strategic Brands
businessLines.how: Sells concentrate and beverage bases to authorized bottlers, who add sweetener and water and sell the finished drink; lower revenue per case, higher gross margin percentage than finished cans, and lumpy with bottler production schedules.
businessLines.description: Energy drink brands acquired from The Coca-Cola Company (acquired from The Coca-Cola Company in 2015, plus affordable brands Predator and Fury; Burn and NOS are named in the 10-K MD&A).

businessLines.name: Alcohol Brands
businessLines.how: Sells kegged and canned malt beverages and seltzers mainly to US beer distributors; lower margins than energy.
businessLines.description: Flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers, kegs and canned, including The Beast and Beast Tea.
